# Year 11 Task 5: Cybersecurity theory blueprint

2027 planning draft · Blueprint; full paper/key not yet authored. Original content CC BY 4.0; example code MIT. Public planning material, not a secure school-issued assessment.

One standard assessment for this slot. The teacher prepares a fresh paper/prototype and item-level marking key using the blueprint.

## Placement

- Type: Theory
- Course weight: 10% (standard task for this slot)
- Proposed local timing: S2 W12 L2 proposed: after security, ciphers and responsible data use; replace a review activity.
- Content family: Unit 2: security threats/controls, security frameworks, ciphers and responsible data use

## Scope and required evidence

- Draft 30 marks of short responses and 20 marks of extended analysis within a 55-minute lesson.
- Allocate items across: security concepts, common ciphers and responsible data use. Prepare an item-level marking key and a new stimulus before issue.
- Require explanation and application to the stimulus, including a labelled diagram or trace where relevant.

## Resources and setup

- Teacher-authored network diagram, requirements/log extract or code trace as appropriate.
- Plain text and accessible diagram version; school-approved permitted materials.
- Included 50-mark planning grid and marking-key template.

## Initial acceptance checks / paper review

- Check every item has an explicit content reference and expected marking points.
- Trial timing with a colleague and check the mark total is 50.
## Conditions to finalise before issue

Teacher sets issue/due dates, permitted references/AI/assistance, supervised-work arrangements, individual-authorship evidence, approved adjustments and the item-level key. Record milestones and use an explanation or small change demonstration to authenticate the same task. Fresh controlled tests and exam keys must be developed privately. Public practice answers cannot establish assessment security.

This is the standard task in its existing slot. It does not add another task to the eight-task outline. Refer to teacher-release-checklist.md and coverage-and-release.md before use.
